headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 29, 2026**
article:
The Cleveland Guardians took down the Cincinnati Reds 6-5 in a thrilling victory, with Kyle Manzardo leading the Guardians' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Guardians' win came just one day after the Reds secured a shutout victory over the Guardians, with JJ Bleday leading the Reds' offense with a home run and an RBI.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including San Francisco Giants left fielder Casey Schmitt, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. Other players on the injured list include Beck Way of the Kansas City Royals, Cole Sands of the Minnesota Twins, Kerry Carpenter of the Detroit Tigers, Spencer Steer of the Cincinnati Reds, Cody Bellinger of the New York Yankees, Shea Langeliers of the Athletics, and Mike Paredes of the Minnesota Twins.

There have been several trades and roster movements in the past few days. The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RF Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in a trade for cash. The Athletics traded RHP Scott Blewett to the Athletics for cash, while the Chicago White Sox traded RHP José Urquidy to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Felix Doroteo.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Guardians 2-0**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with a final score of 2-0. JJ Bleday led the Reds' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Tigers Rout Orioles 14-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 14-0 victory. Eduardo Valencia led the Orioles' offense with 4 hits, 2 home runs, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Edge Pirates in Thrilling 8-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured an 8-7 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, overcoming a late deficit to take the game. Brandon Lowe led the Diamondbacks' offense with a strong performance, going 2-for-5 with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Giants Place Casey Schmitt on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants left fielder Casey Schmitt has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee meniscus tear. The injury occurred on July 28, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rodríguez Traded to Pittsburgh**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates acquired RF Johnathan Rodríguez from the Baltimore Orioles in a trade for cash on July 27, 2026.
